{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pelagonians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] race native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pelagon]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. Due to reflection of their [[Star/Legends|sun's]] rays off the surface of the world's [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], Pelagonians had tough, leathery skin. A patient and determined people, the generation that survived the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assault on Pelagon were grim and pessimistic. They held a deep respect for a person's honor, and cared for quality over quantity.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
